        TrLabel_10TIMES ,TsLabel_10TIMES = sample_gt_variable_samples(gt,args)
        scio.savemat('./weight/Muffl_HSI_train_gt_new.mat', {'train': TrLabel_10TIMES})
        scio.savemat('./weight/Muffl_HSI_test_gt_new.mat', {'test': TsLabel_10TIMES})
        TrLabel_10TIMES = loadmat('./weight/Muffl_HSI_train_gt_new.mat')['train']

    Data1, Data2, TrLabel_10TIMES, TsLabel_10TIMES = readData_args(args)
    print(TsLabel_10TIMES.shape)

import torch
from torch import nn
from einops import rearrange
from thop import profile, clever_format
from mamba_ssm import Mamba
from model.CMF import CMF
import numpy as np
class LayerNorm(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim):
        super(LayerNorm, self).__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
    def forward(self, x):
        h, w = x.shape[-2:]
        x = rearrange(x, 'b c h w -> b (h w) c')
        x = self.norm(x)
        x = rearrange(x, 'b (h w) c -> b c h w', h=h, w=w)
        return x
class GLFE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_chan=64, out_chan=64,  dropout=0.1 ,patch = 9):
        super(GLFE, self).__init__()
        self.layer_norm = LayerNorm(in_chan)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(in_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1)
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(in_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1)
        self.conv4 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(in_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1),
                                   nn.BatchNorm2d(out_chan),
                                   nn.GELU(), )
        self.dw_conv = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(out_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=3, padding=1, groups=out_chan),
                                     nn.BatchNorm2d(out_chan),
                                     nn.GELU(),)
        self.dw_conv_local = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(out_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1, groups=out_chan),
                                     nn.BatchNorm2d(out_chan),
                                     nn.GELU(), )
        self.dw_conv_global = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(out_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1, groups=out_chan),
                                     nn.BatchNorm2d(out_chan),
                                     nn.GELU(), )
        self.conv5 = nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(out_chan, out_chan, kernel_size=1),
                                   nn.BatchNorm2d(out_chan),
                                   nn.GELU(), )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.mamba = Mamba(9*9)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, h, w = x.shape
        x_m = rearrange(x, 'b c h w -> b c (h w)')
        x = self.layer_norm(x)
        conv_out1 =self.conv4(x)
        conv_out = self.dw_conv(conv_out1) + conv_out1
        conv_out = self.dw_conv_local(conv_out)
        mamba_out = self.mamba(x_m)
        mamba_out = mamba_out+x_m
        mamba_out = mamba_out.reshape(b, c, h, w)
        mamba_out = self.dw_conv_global(mamba_out)
        out = self.conv5(conv_out+mamba_out)
        return out
class HetConv(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size_0=3, kernel_size_1=5, stride=1, padding=None, bias=None,
                 p=64, g=16):
        super(HetConv, self).__init__()
        self.gwc1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=kernel_size_0, groups=g,
                              padding=kernel_size_0 // 3, stride=stride)
        self.gwc2 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=kernel_size_1, groups=g, padding=5 // 2, )
        self.pwc = nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size=1, groups=p, stride=stride)
    def forward(self, x):
        a = self.gwc1(x)
        b = self.gwc2(x)
        c = self.pwc(x)
        return a + b + c
class Proposed(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dataset_name):
        super(Proposed, self).__init__()
        if dataset_name == 'Houston2013':
            hsi_dim = 144
            lidar_dim = 1
            num_classes = 15
            d1 = 64
            d2 = 64
            d_state = 16
            expand = 1
        elif dataset_name == 'MUUFL':
            hsi_dim = 64
            lidar_dim = 2
            num_classes = 11
            d1 = 64
            d2 = 64
            d_state =16
            expand = 1
        elif dataset_name == 'Trento':
            hsi_dim = 63
            lidar_dim = 1
            num_classes = 6
            d1 = 64
            d2 = 64
            d_state = 16
            expand = 1
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown dataset: {dataset_name}. Dataset does not exist.")

        self.conv3d_hsi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv3d(in_channels=1, out_channels=8, kernel_size=(5, 3, 3), padding=(2, 1, 1)),
            nn.BatchNorm3d(8),
            nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.Multi_Scale_conv2_HSI = nn.Sequential(
            HetConv(8 * hsi_dim , 16 * 4,
                    p=1,
                  # g=(16 * 4) // 4 if (8 * (144 - 8)) % 16 == 0 else (16 * 4) // 8,
                  g=8  #Trento
                    ),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16 * 4),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.Multi_Scale_conv2_LiDAR = nn.Sequential(
            HetConv(64, 16 * 4,
                    p=1,
                    g=(16 * 4) // 2 if (8 * (1 - 8)) % 16 == 0 else (16* 4) // 4,
                    ),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16 * 4),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        self.conv2d_lidar = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(lidar_dim, out_channels=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding=(1, 1)),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.lgt_hsi1 = GLFE()
        self.lgt_hsi2 = GLFE()
        self.lgt_lidar1 = GLFE()
        self.lgt_lidar2 = GLFE()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(128, num_classes)
        self.CMF1 = CMF(d_model1=d1, d_model2=d2, d_state=d_state, expand=expand)
        self.CMF2 = CMF(d_model1=d1, d_model2=d2, d_state=d_state, expand=expand)
    def forward(self, x1, x2):
        x1 = x1.unsqueeze(1)
        x1 = self.conv3d_hsi(x1)
        x1 = rearrange(x1, 'b c h w y ->b (c h) w y')
        x1 = self.Multi_Scale_conv2_HSI(x1)
        x2 = self.conv2d_lidar(x2)
        x2 = self.Multi_Scale_conv2_LiDAR(x2)
        x1 = self.lgt_hsi1(x1)
        x2 = self.lgt_lidar1(x2)
        out1, out2 = self.CMF1(x1, x2)
        x1 = x1+out1
        x2 = x2+out2
        x1 = self.lgt_hsi2(x1)
        x2 = self.lgt_lidar2(x2)
        out1, out2 = self.CMF2(x1, x2)
        x1 = x1+out1
        x2 = x2+out2
        x1, x2 = self.avg_pool(x1), self.avg_pool(x2)
        out = torch.cat((x1, x2), dim=1)
        out = self.fc(out.squeeze())
        return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    model = Proposed('Trento').cuda()
    model.eval()
    x1, x2 = torch.rand((1, 63, 9, 9)).cuda(), torch.rand((1, 1, 9,9)).cuda()
    flops, params = profile(model, inputs=(x1, x2))
    flops, params = clever_format([flops, params], "%.6f")
    print("FLOPs:", flops, "Parameters:", params)
    y = model(x1, x2)
    print(y.shape)
